senses.gloss: दिङ्नाग दिङ्नाग, i. e. दिश्-, m. an elephant supposed to support a quarter of the world, Megh. 14.

दिङ्-मण्डल दिङ्-मण्डल, i. e. दिश्-, n.
 1. all the quarters of the world, Bhartṛ. 3, 71. 2. the compass-card.
दिङ्मुख दिङ्म्˚, i. e. दिश्-, n. any part of the heavens, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 12.
दिङ्मूढ दिङ्मूढ, i. e. दिश्-, adj. one who has lost the points of the compass, and cannot tell the east from the west, Rām. 3, 60, 3.
